Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE full-body illustrated monster collection icon for the existing Roblox game.
IMAGE 1 supplies the EXACT character identity, outfit, colours and neutral pose. IMAGE 2 supplies ONLY the current game icon illustration style. Follow image 1 for anatomy and clothing; do not copy the deer, horns, eyes, expression or held tool from image 2.
Style: polished 2D hand-painted game icon, crisp bold dark-plum ink outlines, clear cel-shaded volumes, rich colour accents and bright glossy highlights, readable at 64-96 pixels. Match the current Deer collection icon's finish. This is a drawn illustration, not a 3D render, screenshot or photographic texture.
Composition: exactly ONE entire full-body character centred on a square canvas in a mild front three-quarter neutral standing view, filling around 88 percent of the height. Leave clear margins around all headgear, boots, fingers and accessories. Exactly two attached arms and two hands, five fingers per hand including thumb, naturally relaxed at the sides, both hands EMPTY. Genuine transparent alpha background, including arm/body gaps. No floor or cast ground shadow, scenery, base, badge, frame, text, lettering, watermark, duplicate character or added prop.
Identity invariants: this is the HOODED STRANGER from image 1, a tall humanoid with long arms, large pale hands, separate trouser legs and sturdy dark boots. Its unmistakable head is a very BROAD BLACK CLOTH HOOD with rounded sides, deep dark interior and a low overhanging top, containing a SMALL pale HUMAN FACE tapering to a narrow chin. Preserve the hood silhouette and the ratio of small face to big hood. The upper face is washed-out pale and the brow is hidden beneath the canopy: NO visible eyeballs, NO glowing pupils, NO black eye sockets. A slim modeled human nose; the mouth is CLOSED with a thin dark horizontal seam, with restrained dark grey mottling around the lips and chin. Do not turn the face into a skull, smiling cartoon, toothy grin or long open screaming mouth. Render those details as clean illustrated shapes and subtle ink shading, not an embedded blurry photograph. Black hood highlights must remain restrained charcoal/plum so the hood still reads black.

Role-specific costume: Broad golden straw hat with RED ribbon and small wheat sprig worn over the unchanged black hood; tan long-sleeved work shirt, BLUE denim overalls with chest pocket, blue straps and gold buckles, RED neckerchief, brown tool belt and one seed pouch. Pale empty hands at sides. No shovel or pitchfork in the hands.
